## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

content.text:
Good. Static HTML game, canvas. Let's design a great roguelike rhythm game for phone/tablet.

Concept: "NEON TEMPO" or "Beatfall Citadel" — roguelike rhythm where you descend floors of a dungeon, each floor is a rhythm battle. Four lane notes falling toward a hit line; hitting notes charges attacks; enemies attack on beat. Roguelike: after each floor choose one of 3 upgrades/relics. HP, combo, shields, etc.

Need phone/tablet responsive, touch controls, safe areas, no scroll, 60fps.

Let me design carefully for a fun playable loop:

- Lane-based rhythm (4 lanes) with keys D F J K and touch on lanes.
- Notes generated from a chart per floor (procedural patterns seeded by floor & run seed).
- Timing windows: perfect/good/miss. Accuracy builds damage.
- Combat: Player attacks monster automatically? Better: notes = attacks; each hit deals damage scaled by timing and multipliers. Enemies have HP. Enemy telegraphs attacks as "hazard notes" in lanes requiring dodge? That complicates 4-lane tapping.
- Roguelike: floors with 3 combat rooms? Keep scope: one battle per floor, boss every 5 floors. messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable roguelike rhythm game for phone/tablet in the existing `PlayGround` repo, with screenshots saved as small JPEGs for self-checks.

## Requirements
- 2D game targeting phone/tablet, responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas.
- Save screenshots as `.jpg` (viewport ≤1280px wide); read only latest.
- Build request, no clarifying questions; note reasonable assumptions at the end.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/Canvas 2D app (no framework/build step), served by default runtime.
- 4-lane falling-note rhythm combat: notes deal damage to procedurally named enemies; misses cost HP; perfect hits build shield; enemy attacks telegraphed every 8 beats (bosses 6).
- Fever meter (100%) gives double damage/score; 8-beat duration.
- Roguelike loop: endless depths, boss every 5, 3 random upgrade cards after each floor, 20% max-HP heal after wins.
- Procedural WebAudio synthwave music/SFX aligned to chart BPM; AudioContext clock is authoritative game clock; pause via suspend/resume.
- All content generated deterministically from run seed + depth (`mulberry32`), so no assets/network.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full game shell: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `src/main.js`, `src/battle.js`, `src/chart.js`, `src/audio.js`, `src/upgrades.js`, `src/util.js`.
- Title, battle, reward, game-over, how-to-play, and pause screens implemented and visually verified.
- Auto-play test harness via `window.__BEATFALL__` working; verified flow through depth 6 and boss at depth 5.
- Fixed layout bug where title screen lacked `title` class (padding had been 0).
- Fixed `showReward` crash from missing `el.rewardDepth` (now `$('rewardDepth')`).
- Fixed reward horizontal overflow by changing card/foot widths from `96vw` to `100%`.
- Fixed fatal naming collision: judgement effect property `this.judge` overwrote `judge()` method; renamed to `this.judgeFx`.
- Fixed audio errors from `_noise` missing time argument in `miss()`/`hurt()` and null destination fallback.
- Fixed negative `arcTo` radius crash on offscreen hold tails; added guards in `rr()` and tail drawing.
- Improved visuals: single centered judgement text, combo repositioned, fever banner moved top, corrected HP ghost layering, lane color tints, larger enemy core, countdown now renders during pre-roll.
- Mobile portrait and landscape layouts both verified; dynamic canvas offsets scale combo/judgement for short landscape screens.

### Active
- Verifying hold-note sustain rendering with screenshot `screenshots/hold-sustain2.jpg`; hold appears hit/sustained correctly (combo 5, shield 15, notes consumed), but hold tail visualization not yet conclusively inspected.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Confirm hold tail rendering/sustain is visually correct (current screenshot suggests sustain works; tail may be subtle).
2. Fix/verify landscape coach overlap now that CSS media query places `.coach` top and `.fever-banner` bottom for short screens.
3. Test pause/resume and quit-to-title, then game-over/retry flow after latest changes.
4. Run longer auto-flow (auto + auto-select first/random card) to re-check depth 8–10 balance and console cleanliness.
5. Final polish: reward stat chips, disabled `SELECT A RESONANCE` label, title vertical spacing/sun subtlety, seed/depth display if useful.
6. Take final mobile/tablet/landscape screenshots and provide brief assumptions summary.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: screens/HUD markup, modal structure.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive layout, neon visual system, safe areas, landscape media query.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: app state, screen flow, HUD sync, rewards, pause, dev hook/autoplay.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/battle.js`: judgement/combat engine, input, canvas renderer, countdown, particles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/chart.js`: procedural charts, enemy names/stats, attacks, depth scaling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: synth engine, scheduler, SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/upgrades.js`: run state and 15-upgrade pool/offers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/util.js`: RNG/helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: saved check images (latest: `hold-sustain2.jpg`, `battle-landscape2.jpg`, `reward5.jpg`, `pause2.jpg`).

## Important Context
- Dev server runs in tmux session `game` on port 3000 via `./start.sh`; browser session is `playwright-cli -s=game` (viewport currently 390×844).
- `window.__BEATFALL__` exposes `{battle, run, audio, startNewRun, setAutoPlay}`; `setAutoPlay(true)` uses direct `pressLane` automation.
- Playwright needed `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` once; browser cache now has chromium-1243.
- Auto-play reached depth 6 with upgrades `overdrive, rebound×2, siphon`; best stored values currently depth 06 / score ~42,338.
- Known console error was stale (`this.judge is not a function`, negative `arcTo`) and is fixed in source, but server/browser may need reload.
- `start.sh` serves the repo root; changes are live after reload, no build step.
- Latest screenshot showed depth 1, HP 200 (test override), enemy 184/220, combo 5, shield 15, PERFECT, hold being sustained; no visible errors.
